title: Nice mug, keeps liquids cold or hot
text: Nice mug, keeps liquids cold or hot. It isn't leak proof, but it does keep the liquid hot or cold.  It says "Diety" bless on the bottom.  I didn't realize this, but thought I should point it out.  The outside is nice and comfortable in hand.
